candidate_program.name: reward_with_soft_occupancy
candidate_program.rationale: Retains reward scale with a modest bounded penalty for resource gap overhead relative to contact duration. Reach is root-only with few scalar operations; common-kernel work still applies, and the occupancy proxy ignores graph displacement.
candidate_program.rule: weight * (1 - 0.15 * max(station_gap, satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
